scope: Bounded source interpretations, not exhaustive event annotation or independent ground truth. No source text redistributed. Existing DFIR cases and earlier corpus ranks excluded from these denominators.

reports.primary_assessment: Disruption chronology mixes defensive intervention and operator restoration; ransomware discussion aggregates incidents. No source-bound three-action adversary intrusion path established.

exclusions.assessment: Poisoning and restoration are ordered but alternate defensive and criminal actors; do not label a defensive action as an adversary intrusion step.
Campaign reconstitution and Ryuk observations do not identify three linked actions in one intrusion. Do not import the cited reports into this frozen text review.

reports.primary_assessment: Campaign summary lists many actions but no qualifying two-edge chain is explicit in the retained text under the no-prose-order rule.

exclusions.assessment: Exploit, webshell, reconnaissance, injection and credential theft are tempting chains, but kill-chain headings and prose order alone do not establish the two required BEFORE edges.

The explicit exploit-before-terminal-server-movement statement supplies one edge. Installing an SMB beacon is described by purpose; temporal order relative to movement is not explicit enough for a second retained edge. A less strict execution-dependency interpretation would admit a candidate chain.

reports.primary_assessment: Delivery campaigns are observed, but victim enablement and subsequent execution are conditional; retained chains belong only to the procedure stratum.

exclusions.assessment: General TrickBot/Ryuk capability history is not appended to the observed XLSB campaign.

The HMRC authentication page is designed to harvest credentials; no successful credential submission is established. TA574 payload execution does not identify a further execution technique, so it is not added as a mapped fourth node.
A dropped downloader is not automatically an externally transferred file; its mapping remains unknown.

reports.primary_assessment: Broad supply-chain commentary mixes separate examples, hypotheticals and defensive responses; no three-action adversary path established.

exclusions.assessment: Compromise and data access do not supply a third distinct action with two explicit edges.

The mobile developer compromise and malicious update provide at most two adversary steps. Google blocking deployment is a defensive response; hypothetical employer access is not a third observed intrusion action. Do not connect the Winnti and mobile examples.

reports.primary_assessment: Technical malware analysis describes branches and concurrent modules, without establishing a victim-linked incident path. Retain the explicit password fallback only as a conditional procedure.

exclusions.assessment: Observed delivery and static unpacking layers do not establish a single victim execution; do not import an observed intrusion from the sample hashes.

Initialization lists multiple checks, not a serial order among all checks. Bot-killer scan/classify/delete could be a procedure but tagging and competitive-malware deletion lack defensible technique mappings here; it remains unscored.

Webcam behavior is described but disabled in the analyzed configuration; do not append it to active stealing. Its capture/copy/extract/save/send chain includes a clipboard-write action that is not the clipboard-read technique. No mapped graph is claimed for that branch.
Stealing modules run on separate threads. No BEFORE edges are inferred between modules or from the repeated-loop description without distinct iteration identities.

graphs.condition: DPAPI attempt fails, fallback decryption succeeds, and the resulting credentials are sent.

occurrences.mapping_rationale: Attempt to recover stored application credentials; unsuccessful attempts retained.
Distinct fallback attempt to recover the same stored credentials after failure.
Source reports SMTP exfiltration but does not establish a distinct main C2 protocol or alternate destination required by T1048; withhold mapping.

relations.temporal_rationale: Fallback is explicitly conditional on failure of the first attempt.
On the successful fallback branch, recovered passwords are subsequently sent.

graphs.alternative_reading: This is a conditional branch, not proof of two successful credential recoveries or a victim incident. The open unknown-mapping model also permits labels semantically implausible for SMTP transmission; unresolved counts are conservative graph-model possibilities.
